mechanism_narrative: A persistent decline in the federal funds rate over 3 consecutive months indicates the Federal Reserve is shifting to an easing stance, which lowers discount rates and increases the present value of expected equity cash flows, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day forward returns in > 60% of observed easing cycles, or the 20-day forward return is not statistically higher than the 5-day average (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the federal funds rate above 5.25% signals tightening monetary policy, which raises the opportunity cost of capital and reduces the present value of expected equity cash flows, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day forward returns in > 60% of tightening cycles, or the 20-day forward return is not statistically lower than the 5-day average (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in monthly employment growth (PAYEMS) above 200,000 jobs indicates a strengthening labor market, which boosts consumer confidence and corporate earnings expectations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in strengthening labor periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sudden drop in monthly employment growth (PAYEMS) below -50,000 jobs signals a labor market contraction, which raises uncertainty and compresses earnings expectations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in contraction periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly industrial production index (INDPRO) above 105 signals robust manufacturing activity, which supports corporate earnings and equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in expansion periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly industrial production index (INDPRO) below 95 indicates weak manufacturing momentum, which compresses earnings expectations and equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in weak momentum periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in consumer price inflation (CPIAUCSL) below 3% signals deflationary pressure, which reduces the real value of equity cash flows and compresses valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in deflation periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in consumer price inflation (CPIAUCSL) above 3.5% signals accelerating demand, which raises the real discount rate and compresses equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in accelerating demand periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).
